name: process-retrospective
description: Run general evidence-based process retrospectives, compare telemetry windows when available, use rotating lenses without narrowing scope, and propose one or more improvements without applying them automatically.

INTERVAL_SECONDS.prompt: Default seconds between retrospective passes. Minimum one hour.

INITIAL_DELAY_SECONDS.prompt: Default delay before the first retrospective pass.

PASSES_PER_FOCUS.prompt: Number of passes before rotating to another analytical focus.

REVIEW_WINDOW_HOURS.prompt: Recent activity window considered by each retrospective.
